title: Thin-Topic Authority Foundations, 2023-2026
summary: Eight reviewed primary records that establish bounded evidence foundations for AI-enabled manufacturing, critical-infrastructure AI governance, agricultural outlooks, post-quantum implementation, cybersecurity baselines, and Phoenix industrial water management.
scope: The first Phase 55S authority sprint pairs high-value official rails with specific documents. It emphasizes topics that were thin in the FTFN corpus and separates research priorities, voluntary guidance, forecasts, preliminary laboratory evidence, and regulatory requirements from demonstrated implementation or outcomes.
download_note: The 11-file archive contains eight official-link records, consolidated summaries, a README, and a SHA-256 manifest. Each link record preserves the reviewed official URL and the collection's interpretation boundary.
method_note: A document is included because it supplies a stable primary record for a thin FTFN topic. Research roadmaps are not deployments; concept notes and preliminary drafts are not final requirements; voluntary frameworks are not compliance evidence; forecasts are not observed outcomes; and area-wide water rules are not project water allocations, service commitments, or operating results.
